column5: The SDK's battery monitoring setter decodes this writable string pointer immediately after the UIDevice class and supplies the result to class_getProperty.
The local function following SetBatteryMonitoringStatus uses objc_lookUpClass and class_getProperty. Both slices match its compiled C body.
Both oversize branches in GetEncryptedData call this function. The matched callee writes a one to field 20 and encrypts that short replacement message.
GetEncryptedData calls this function with the complete input and output blocks. It checks both pointers and then calls the named bit-sliced transform.
